# Quick Review

![](images/Recitation%206_0.png)



* __Swearing__  \(or cursing\, cussing\, etc\.\) is the use of words that are deemed taboo \(by a community\) to express the emotional state of the speaker
  * Focus on  __connotation __ and  __perception__
  * Returned to historical linguistics\, morphology\, and pragmatics

---




* We explored the ideas about how words get their meanings:
* History
  * Comparative reconstruction
  * [https://www\.etymonline\.com/](https://www.etymonline.com/search?q=shit)
* Morphological processes
  * Affixes \(includes prefixes\, suffixes\, infixes\)
  * English infixation\!
* Usage
  * Politeness \(negative and positive\)
  * Saving face

# Activity time!
